config.database: fresh temporary SQLite; removed after scoring
config.scoring: all queries: exact status/value + exact event ID set + ledger citation validity
config.date_policy: date-only queries mean end-of-day UTC; known_at is optional
config.baseline_policy: same scope; observed_at<=as_of and known_at if given; max(observed_at,event_id); ignores event_type/effective_at/correction links
config.project_leakage_unit: number of queries containing any out-of-project candidate/citation
